checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable 15-second widescreen film with three sequential scenes
must.why: One continuous 15s clip, but it shows the tea story, not the wet-bench / newspaper three-scene story.

must.item: Woman curly black bob and yellow raincoat; man white beard and blue coat
must.why: Woman has straight brown hair in a ponytail, gray coat and mustard scarf. Man has gray hair, no beard, gray coat.
Bench looks dry; no rain or wetness is visible.

must.item: Man offers folded newspaper; ending shows both seated and smiling
must.why: No newspaper. Both are seated at the end, but they are drinking tea and not clearly smiling.

must.item: Live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack
must.why: Photoreal look. The brief asked for silence, and none can be heard or seen to be present.

faults.what: Wrong story: tea gesture instead of newspaper on a wet bench; the must-have characters, costumes and wet bench are all missing
Man and woman do not match the required look (no white beard or blue coat, no curly black bob or yellow raincoat)
Man's hands gesture oddly and the cups are held awkwardly; faces drift slightly between frames; mild AI look

summary: A realistic, well-composed autumn park clip of an older man and a young woman sharing tea, but it misses the required wet bench, newspaper, character looks and three-scene structure.
